name: @splunk/splunk-ui-mcp

tools.name: list_splunk_ui_requirements
tools.description:
🔧 **For Agents:** ALWAYS call this tool first to fetch exact version constraints for Splunk UI packages and peer dependencies required by the Splunk UI Design System before scaffolding a new project; after use the check_setup tool to verify.

Returns the Splunk UI design system requirements as JSON.

tools.name: find_icon
tools.description: Search @splunk/react-icons for the best match and a few alternatives based on your keyword.

query.description: The search query for the icon, e.g., "search", "notification", "user".

tools.name: find_component
tools.description: Finds @splunk/react-ui components by exact name or fuzzy query. Returns full docs for exact matches and ranked suggestions for discovery queries.

tools.name: find_design_token
tools.description: Search for a Splunk UI design token from @splunk/themes. In Splunk UI projects, all styling must use styled-components and design tokens for CSS properties as much as possible — never hardcode hex values, rgb(), or CSS custom properties like var(--something). Call this tool whenever you need a color, spacing, typography, shadow, or z-index value.

query.description: What you are trying to style, e.g. "button background", "paragraph text color", "input border", "modal background", "spacing between elements", "focus shadow".

tools.name: find_guidance
tools.description: Find guidance for designing and building UI experiences that follow documented patterns and conventions. Use this tool to inform layout, interaction, visual design, and development decisions, alongside component and design-token tools for implementation details. Search by topic to discover relevant guides, then use an exact guide name to retrieve its Markdown. Some guides return links to documentation that you must open to read the guidance.

query.description: Exact guide name or a single topic or keyword (e.g., "Theming", "Design levers", "Glow", "CRUD"). Search different topics in separate calls.

instructions:
Use this server to help design and build UI applications to follow documented patterns and conventions.

When designing or changing a UI experience, consult relevant guidance to inform the approach before choosing components and implementation details. Apply that guidance alongside component, icon, and design-token documentation as you build.

Choose tools according to the information you need:
- find_guidance: discover and read patterns and conventions that inform UI design and development decisions.
- find_component: retrieve component APIs, usage guidance, and examples.
- find_icon: find icons.
- find_design_token: find design tokens.

For guidance searches, translate the task into a relevant topic or keyword. Search one topic at a time. Use returned guide names for exact lookups to retrieve their Markdown. MCP resource links are another way to read that content.

Some guides contain pointers to portal documentation. Read the linked page before using its guidance. If unavailable, follow the pointer's documentation-index link. Base recommendations on content you actually read, and state when relevant guidance could not be accessed.

Use list_splunk_ui_requirements for package-version and installation advice. Surface returned availability and version warnings when they affect your recommendations.
